methods.formula: Value = (assets in place + C − net debt) ÷ shares;  C = S·N(d₁) − K·e^(−rT)·N(d₂), d₁ = [ln(S ÷ K) + (r + σ²/2)T] ÷ σ√T, d₂ = d₁ − σ√T
steps: S = the expansion in year 5: the revenue it adds $13.20B (to $22.65B) × margin 16.5% × (1 − tax), as a growing perpetuity, discounted = $8.48B
K = capital to build it: $13.20B ÷ sales-to-capital 0.48 = $27.33B
σ = 78% (its stock, a year of daily closes), T = 5 years, r = 4.91% → C = $3.68B
assets in place = NOPAT $1.35B ÷ WACC = $10.48B; value = ($10.48B + $3.68B − net debt $1.03B) ÷ 921,200,000 = $14.25
